title: War, Ownership Shifts, and the $74K Signal
script_summary:
**ORACLE BRIEF**

Individual Bitcoin ownership peaked in 2024—institutions are buying what you're selling. At $74,200 during active US-Iran hostilities, this isn't recovery. It's repricing.

**Three signals hitting hard:**

One—Hash rate just hit post-halving highs at 810 exahashes. Miners aren't capitulating. They're adding compute during a geopolitical war. Long-term holder supply is 70% of circulating coins. The hands holding through this aren't selling.
